Overall verdict: needs_changes. Implementer target declaration matches `{Repo: DontPanic, Env: dev, Project: (none)}`, and I found no forbidden command shapes in their recorded `target_context.commands_run`.

FINDING (high, correctness): `environments/Firebase` can report `ok` for a present-but-unloadable `environments.json`, violating the class-wide non-optimistic status invariant. Evidence: [config_inventory.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/config_inventory.py:1126) catches `load_environments(...)` exceptions, changes the summary to “validation deferred,” then still returns `Status.OK if configured else OPTIONAL_UNCONFIGURED` at line 1138. The invariant test’s environments case only uses “no project” ([test_config_inventory_f008.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_config_inventory_f008.py:587)), so it does not catch a real unloadable env file. Recommendation: make unloadable `environments.json` non-ok and add that real invalid-state case to the parametrized invariant suite.

$ PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts python -c "from dontpanic_orchestrate import
